name: AA-Omniscience
intro: AA-Omniscience 用 6 个领域、42 个经济相关主题的 6,000 道精确短答题评估模型的事实召回与知识校准。问题由 GPT-5 从权威、较新的信源生成、过滤和修订，再经人工复核。模型在无上下文、无工具条件下回答或弃答，由 Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview 四分类判分；公开集是另行按分布和模型性能对齐抽样的 600 题代表性子集。
build_method: 权威信源筛选, GPT-5问题生成/过滤/修订, 人工复核
eval_feature: 闭卷知识召回, 知识校准, 弃答与幻觉
build_method_en: Authoritative source selection, GPT-5 question generation/filtering/revision, human review
eval_feature_en: Closed-book factual recall, knowledge calibration, abstention and hallucination
intro_en: AA-Omniscience evaluates factual recall and knowledge calibration with 6,000 precise short-answer questions spanning 42 economically relevant topics in six domains. GPT-5 generates, filters, and revises questions from authoritative recent sources before human review. Models answer or abstain without context or tools, and Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview assigns four-way grades. A separate distribution- and model-performance-aligned sample of 600 questions is public.

drawio_review_note: REDRAW reviewed against arXiv:2511.13029v1 Sections 2.1-2.4 and Appendix B plus the public Hugging Face dataset at 4a8ffc87c4650054825fb767fe0da4a4fc97ff32. The diagram explicitly separates GPT-5 generation, filtering, and revision; manual validation; the full 6,000-question evaluation set; and distribution- plus performance-aligned sampling of the public 600. Only the full set feeds the evaluation mainline; the public set remains a publication branch.
